source_refs.note: Sub-heading 'Domain Name System (DNS)' of 1.7 as printed (PDF 14-15, printed 9-10).

blocks.text: DNS stands for Domain Name System. It converts website names into IP addresses. DNS makes websites easy to access (as shown in Figure 1.14). Users do not need to remember numbers. DNS servers perform this translation process. It plays a key role in Internet use.

blocks.alt: DNS name resolution in one row: a screen showing www.example.com, an arrow to a globe marked DNS, an arrow to a server in a cloud, and an arrow to the IP address 93.184.216.34.
blocks.caption: Figure 1.14: DNS Name Resolution Process (original drawing after the textbook's Figure 1.14).

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: DNS works behind the scenes every time a website is opened.
